storage_policy.git_policy: Only registry metadata, adapter code, docs, and tiny synthetic test fixtures may be tracked. Raw measured data, normalized measured samples, and derived measured outputs stay out of Git.

datasets.display_name: KTH radar measurements on drones, birds and humans with a 77GHz FMCW sensor
datasets.citation: Karlsson, Alexander. Radar measurements on drones, birds and humans with a 77GHz FMCW sensor. Zenodo, v2.0, 2021. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.5896641.
datasets.claim_boundary: Use for distribution-distance calibration of public-proxy radar products; do not claim object-specific measured truth or operational sensor performance.
datasets.notes: Best first airborne hard-negative anchor for drone-vs-bird/human micro-Doppler realism.

datasets.display_name: Open Radar Initiative Outdoor Moving Object Dataset
datasets.citation: Gusland et al. Open Radar Initiative: Large Scale Dataset for Benchmarking of micro-Doppler Recognition Algorithms. IEEE Radar Conference, 2021.
datasets.claim_boundary: Use for observable product distributions and domain holdout checks; non-commercial license limits redistribution and downstream use.
datasets.notes: Strong match for surveillance-style observable radar products and everyday confusers.

datasets.display_name: Time-synchronized multi-sensor drone dataset acquired from multiple radars and RF receiver
datasets.citation: Han, S.-K. and Jung, Y.-H. A Time-Synchronized Multi-Sensor drone dataset acquired from multiple radars and RF receiver. Scientific Data 13, 407, 2026.
datasets.claim_boundary: Do not adapt, redistribute, or derive committed artifacts from this dataset until data license and citation requirements are confirmed.
datasets.notes: Promising direct drone radar/RF anchor; remains reference-only until access and license are checked locally.

datasets.citation: Real Doppler RAD-DAR database, Kaggle; associated publication DOI: 10.1049/iet-rsn.2019.0307.
datasets.claim_boundary: Use as a compact public Doppler benchmark after Kaggle terms are accepted locally; no raw or normalized samples may be committed.
datasets.notes: Good compact benchmark but gated behind Kaggle authentication and terms.

datasets.citation: García-Gascón et al. An open benchmark dataset for machine learning and intelligent trajectory optimization in fixed-wing unmanned aerial systems. Scientific Data 13, 364, 2026.
datasets.claim_boundary: Not a radar validation source; use only for broad public fixed-wing kinematic phase priors.
datasets.notes: Useful for public-proxy fixed-wing phase priors, not radar measured-anchor promotion.

datasets.display_name: RaDICaL synchronized 77GHz FMCW raw ADC dataset
datasets.citation: Lim, Markowitz, and Do. RaDICaL: A Synchronized FMCW Radar, Depth, IMU and RGB Camera Data Dataset with Low-Level FMCW Radar Signals. Illinois Data Bank, 2021. DOI: 10.13012/B2IDB-3289560_V1.
datasets.claim_boundary: Automotive/indoor controlled anchor for raw signal-chain validation, not C-UAS performance truth.
datasets.notes: Large downloads; valuable once raw ADC processing support is in scope.

datasets.display_name: Raw ADC data of 77GHz mmWave radar for automotive object detection
datasets.citation: Gao et al. Raw ADC Data of 77GHz MMWave Radar for Automotive Object Detection. IEEE Dataport, 2022.
datasets.claim_boundary: Use for automotive raw ADC chain checks only after data terms are verified.
datasets.notes: Repository code is MIT; dataset license must be checked at the download source before use.

datasets.citation: Rebut et al. Raw High-Definition Radar for Multi-Task Learning. CVPR, 2022.
datasets.claim_boundary: Automotive raw radar anchor; do not infer C-UAS target fidelity.
datasets.notes: Strong raw radar benchmark; license status must be verified before local use.

datasets.display_name: RADDet range-azimuth-Doppler radar object detection dataset
datasets.citation: Zhang et al. RADDet: Range-Azimuth-Doppler Based Radar Object Detection for Dynamic Road Users. CRV, 2021.
datasets.claim_boundary: Use for tensor processing validation; not an airborne target realism claim.
datasets.notes: Download links have changed historically, so retrieval remains explicit/manual.

datasets.display_name: CARRADA camera and automotive radar with range-angle-Doppler annotations
datasets.citation: Ouaknine et al. CARRADA Dataset: Camera and Automotive Radar with Range-Angle-Doppler Annotations. ICPR, 2020.
datasets.claim_boundary: Non-commercial share-alike dataset; use only for tensor processing validation and never commit derived measured tensors.
datasets.notes: Large dataset and RAD tensor downloads; not first-priority for C-UAS takeoff realism.

datasets.display_name: K-Radar 4D radar object detection in various weather conditions
datasets.citation: Paek et al. K-Radar: 4D Radar Object Detection for Autonomous Driving in Various Weather Conditions. NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks, 2022.
datasets.claim_boundary: Later adverse-weather domain anchor only; ND license blocks adapted measured outputs from being shared.
datasets.notes: Very large, weather-rich automotive anchor; not first-priority for C-UAS takeoff.

datasets.display_name: RADIATE radar dataset in adverse weather
datasets.citation: Sheeny et al. RADIATE: A Radar Dataset for Automotive Perception. arXiv:2010.09076, 2020.
datasets.claim_boundary: Later adverse-weather robustness anchor; not an airborne object signature source.
datasets.notes: Weather and large-scene clutter anchor after first C-UAS measured-anchor support exists.
